description: Full fault injection matrix for FinalizeTaskExecution atomic operation (ban_ke_hoach.md §2 test matrix)

fault_injection_points.name: lease_validation_fencing_mismatch
fault_injection_points.simulated_failure: Fencing token mismatch — stale worker holds expired fencing token

fault_injection_points.name: cas_state_update_version_mismatch
fault_injection_points.simulated_failure: Task version mismatch (expected=1, actual=2) — late result from old worker
fault_injection_points.expected_outcome: StaleResultRejectedError raised, late result rejected, no state mutation

fault_injection_points.name: outbox_writer_failure
fault_injection_points.simulated_failure: Database exception during outbox insert (RuntimeError injected)
fault_injection_points.expected_outcome: Full transaction rollback: task state remains running, lease remains active, 0 outbox records

fault_injection_points.name: result_persistence_failure
fault_injection_points.expected_outcome: Full rollback: task running, lease active, 0 result records

fault_injection_points.name: event_store_insert_failure
fault_injection_points.simulated_failure: EventStore.append() raises RuntimeError before outbox write
fault_injection_points.expected_outcome: Full rollback: task running, no outbox records for the failed task

fault_injection_points.name: lease_release_failure
fault_injection_points.simulated_failure: Lease status update raises RuntimeError after CAS succeeds but before commit
fault_injection_points.expected_outcome: Full rollback: task running (v1), lease still active

fault_injection_points.name: commit_failure
fault_injection_points.simulated_failure: SqlUnitOfWork.commit() raises RuntimeError (simulate connection loss / serialization failure)
fault_injection_points.expected_outcome: No persistence: task running, lease active, 0 results, 0 outbox records

fault_injection_points.name: idempotency_deduplication_on_retry
fault_injection_points.expected_outcome: already_finalized=True on retry, exactly 1 outbox and 1 result record, no duplicates

fault_injection_points.name: crash_after_commit_idempotent_recovery
fault_injection_points.simulated_failure: Worker crashes after DB commit, before internal ACK. Recovery leader retries same idempotency_key.
fault_injection_points.expected_outcome: Second attempt returns already_finalized=True. Exactly 1 outbox, 1 result, version=2.
